import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from treap import Priors, fat_insert, fat_pop, fat_charge_less, fat_lag, fat_pairs
def brute_check(n=250, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed); pr=Priors(); root=None; model={}; ver=0
    for step in range(n):
        op = rng.random()
        if op < 0.5 or not model:
            key=(rng.randint(0,4), step)
            if key in model: continue
            root = fat_insert(root, key, ('r',key), pr.take(), ver); model[key]=0
        else:
            key = rng.choice(list(model))
            root, lag = fat_pop(root, key, ver, 0)
            assert lag == model.pop(key), (seed,step,'lag')
        if rng.random() < 0.5 and model:
            thr = rng.randint(0,4); lim=(thr,0)
            root, cnt = fat_charge_less(root, lim, ver)
            ecnt = sum(1 for k in model if k[0] < thr)
            assert cnt == ecnt, (seed,step,'cnt',cnt,ecnt,sorted(model))
            for k in list(model):
                if k[0] < thr: model[k] += 1
        pairs=[]; fat_pairs(root,0,pairs); got={}
        for p,l in pairs: got[p[1]]=l
        assert got == model, (seed,step,'pairs',got,model)
        for k,v in model.items(): assert fat_lag(root,k)==v, (seed,step,k)
    return True
for s in range(120): brute_check(250, s)
print('treap brute: all ok')
